body:
Otis Bardwell drives a reconstructed occupied wagon circuit in 1835, and Hans Johnson drives a Brougham circuit in 1904, in Full or Balanced detail. Walk up and use Interact to Stop or Continue; Step back checks visitor clearance. Driver picks and Find use the named person and vehicle’s current position. Light retires the occupied assembly and restores standing-person ownership.

Current pushed HEAD is `a6207b493f7ce06052e9e211245631a1e07f8df1`, TREE `0472b3e7d758fe265e93b2d6f508cf91564286f6`. It preserves the registered Inspector preload, driver-card data warmup, prioritized route continuations, route/model safety checks, existing provenance, standing idles and memory repairs. Latest DEV walking-path, bridge, building-dressing and changelog changes are integrated. Independent reviews preserved all owned runtime/CI files and incoming assets.

The prior whole CI gate took 29minutes and ended with one failure among 1154steps: the isolated empty-scene fixture lacked the new `draws`/card-preparation dependencies. The fixture now uses actual scene-layer bindings, retains every old assertion and tests no card/model activity for empty rows and Light. The original fixture passes in the actual app checkout.

CI now runs the existing complete native partition in eight parallel jobs. The original required check remains `gate` and succeeds only when all eight jobs succeed. Each part retains its 600second ceiling. Full history, reader/base requirements, dependencies, pool selection, event/permission/runners and changelog-entry checks are unchanged. The existing native harness passes 50checks including 14 deliberate workflow-fault refusals. This gate change unblocks this visible transport parcel; it does not reduce project coverage or quality settings.

Validation and remaining delivery work:

- Current integration passed 13 actual native/targeted commands, including transport, driven assembly, Navigator, empty scenes, native harness, report owners/checks, all-asset validation and structure clearance. All 17 owned source files match the preceding checked increment exactly.
- All five actual-HEAD changelog/identifier checks, whitespace, normal push, source guards and Git/PR readback pass. Current committed-HEAD native publication/validation and final all-asset validation pass.
- On current a620, the complete native CI gate and its required aggregate pass: 1,155 distinct steps, 401 self-tests, all eight matching part footers, original reader/base requirements and 600-second caps. The slowest part took 367 seconds. All nine current frame/memory jobs also succeed. Moving-frame and published-release checks also succeed; the complete native upload-release result is PASS32 checks. All 30 current check runs have completed with no failures (23 success, 7 expected skips). Previous 7d results remain separately scoped.
- Actual current a620 phone world: occupied carriage mount passes in 148.770 seconds within its original 300-second cap; the correct Hans card/census passes in 25.882 seconds within 30. The complete 790.44m producer route is sampled at 3,163 points. Find remains NONPASS: the first touchStart acknowledgement took 32.886 seconds, above the unchanged 30-second input budget. A later cleanup release delivered one trusted Find click and the visitor moved 0.570m with stopped/approach; that postdeadline effect is not a timed acceptance pass. Light/screenshot acceptance remains unrun. Actual 1835 desktop route and independent whole-circuit checks also pass, but keyboard approach exceeds its original 30-second wait before reaching Interact; Stop is not claimed from that case. The direct in-reach 1904 desktop Stop/Continue case is running. Supplemental world acceptance is incomplete; original negatives and limits are retained.

[Immutable current checkpoints, fixture repairs and earlier failures](https://github.com/kevinrhaas/chicago-evidence/blob/0524faba0fc5f6f82a8a6a3c6df42d39f25aed41/evidence/transport-pr1649-a620-checkpoint-and-native-fixtures-2026-11-04-0110Z/MANIFEST.json). Current in-flight world/CI receipts will be saved separately.

This is an incremental DEV delivery with every current project CI check complete and no failures. Supplemental walk-up and mobile input timing acceptance remains open, alongside broader photographic appearance, anatomy, natural gait, boarding, riding and natural seated animation. T1790, T2804 and T3088 remain claimed with no PR closure association; none is marked fully done by this parcel. The prepared driver look-motion increment is separate. No production promotion is requested or claimed.
